singular VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: singular registry COMMAND

Create a registry and read its keys

Creation makes the registry of an application: its state, a single output that
holds the registry's token and the root of its keys. The registry is named by
its seed, an output of your wallet, and by the application whose policy the
state validator is made for. Creation takes the compiled validators of the
release (--blueprint) and a single signer. Inspect reads a registry address
and a key without either.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

Available commands:
  create    Create the registry of an application  
  inspect   Read a key and identify its application
